title: Superagency: What Could Possibly Go Right with Our AI Future

title: Co-Intelligence: Living and Working with AI

title: The Anthropic Economic Index

title: AI Risk Management Framework and Generative AI Profile
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
summary: Map, Measure, Manage, Govern framework for risk-proportional AI deployment and governance.

authors: U.S. Department of Education Office of Educational Technology
summary: Education report framing AI around teaching, learning, assessment, equity, privacy, and human judgment.

title: Brave New Words: How AI Will Revolutionize Education (and Why That's a Good Thing)

title: AI as Normal Technology / AI Snake Oil
publication: AI as Normal Technology Substack / AI Snake Oil book project

title: Guidance for Safe Foundation Model Deployment
